import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from src.dispatcher import export
assert export([{"id": 1, "name": "Alice"}], "csv") == "id,name\n1,Alice\n"
assert export([{"id": 1, "name": "Alice"}], "json") == '[{"id":"1","name":"Alice"}]'
assert export([], "csv") == "id,name\n"
assert export([], "json") == "[]"

# Shared pipeline checks
from src.exporter import export_rows
from src.csv_exporter import export_csv
from src.json_exporter import export_json
rows = [{"id": 1, "name": None, "extra": "x"}, {"name": 'a,"b"\nc'}, {"id": "é", "name": "ü"}]
orig = [dict(r) for r in rows]
assert export_csv(rows) == export_rows(rows, "csv") == 'id,name\n1,\n,"a,""b""\nc"\né,ü\n'
assert export_json(rows) == export_rows(rows, "json") == '[{"id":"1","name":""},{"id":"","name":"a,\\"b\\"\\nc"},{"id":"é","name":"ü"}]'
assert rows == orig
assert export_csv(iter(rows)) == export_csv(rows)
assert export_json(r for r in rows) == export_json(rows)
assert export_rows([], "csv") == "id,name\n" and export_rows(iter([]), "json") == "[]"
for bad in ("xml", "CSV", None, ["csv"]):
    for fn in (lambda b: export_rows([], b), lambda b: export([], b)):
        try:
            fn(bad)
        except ValueError:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError(bad)
print("ok")
